messages:
anya: heads-up — Greenline onboarding hitting intermittent 429s when their Electron app opens multiple windows. Happens ~5–10s after start, not consistent. They repro locally.

greenline-integration: @anya thanks. We saw spikes in our metrics too — request bursts from multiple renderer processes. Sample log: `{"status":429, "retry_after": 1}`. We use the browser SDK inside an iframe + a service worker.

devin: @greenline-integration can you paste the init snippet and headers? suspect duplicate preflight or service worker proxying requests.

greenline-integration: yep — snippet below. We create three BrowserWindow instances each with same preload that calls init.

```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk';
Redwood.init({
  key: 'sk-prod-REDACTED',
  clientId: 'greenline-web',
  telemetry: true
});
```

greenline-integration: headers on a failing request: `Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-..., X-Client-Id: greenline-web, Content-Type: application/json`

devin: thx. Two things to check: 1) service worker might forward requests from multiple windows without connection re-use — can you confirm whether you proxy through a service worker fetch handler? 2) are all windows creating parallel SDK clients or sharing a single page-level client?

greenline-integration: we register a service worker that intercepts fetch and forwards to network (no caching). Each window has its own SDK instance.

sam: tagging again — we have rate windows for per-key concurrent burst control. If multiple renderer processes open rapidly, we can see 429s at the edge even if overall QPS is low. Suggest coalescing init calls or client-side jitter.

anya: customer asked for concrete mitigation steps. can we recommend a quick change that doesn't need infra work?

onboard-bot: Note: DevDoc link — https://console.redwood.ai/docs/browser-sdk#service-workers

devin: quick mitigation options (ranked):
- Add a short randomized startup jitter before calling init (50–300ms) across windows.
- Make the service worker stash an ephemeral token in IndexedDB and reuse it across windows.
- If possible, initialize one shared client in the main process and proxy calls to renderers.

greenline-integration: ok will try jitter + single token reuse. do you recommend changing retry headers or backoff client-side?

sam: client-side exponential backoff with jitter is fine. Also set `maxConcurrency` lower in the SDK if you can. We can also temporarily bump their key window in the rate limiter for the onboarding account — requires ops approval.

anya: can we do ops bump for the next 24h? It'd smooth the onboarding flow.

devin: create an ops ticket referencing key `sk-prod-REDACTED` (redact in ticket) — I can approve a limited window increase. Also send us a small repro (dev build) so we can run a load trace.

greenline-integration: will send repro and try jitter now. ETA ~30m. thanks all :pray:

anya: perfect. i'll wait for repro and then open ops request if the jitter doesn't fully fix it. keep me posted.

devin: one more note — check client clock skew and token renewal times. If windows refresh tokens simultaneously during startup, that creates a renewal fanout. Stagger refresh interval by random offset.

greenline-integration: good catch. we'll add jitter to refresh too. thanks!

anya: marking follow-up: confirm after repro and ops decision.

onboard-bot: Reminder set: follow up in 24h about Greenline onboarding rate smoothing.
